title: SG-8.4.3 Show 'No suggestions yet this round' for an empty loaded history
summary: Contribution modal shows an empty-history message once history loads empty and hides it after an entry is added
description: Context: ContributionSheet loads the player's history with listMine and tracks historyStatus ('loading' | 'ready' | 'error'), but renders nothing when the load succeeds with zero entries. Desired behavior: when history loaded successfully and there are no entries, show 'No suggestions yet this round'; hide it as soon as an entry is added. Expected result: the player sees an explicit empty state. Why: an empty list is otherwise indistinguishable from a broken one.
acceptance_criteria: Given listMine resolves with an empty list, when the sheet is open, then the text 'No suggestions yet this round' is visible.
Given the empty message is visible, when the player submits an idea and an entry appears (sending, sent or failed), then the message is no longer in the document.
Given history is loading or failed to load, then the empty message is not shown.

out_of_scope: Loading and error states, which already exist
preserve: Existing loading, error, Retry, validation, quota and submit behavior

technical_constraints: Use the existing historyStatus state and entries list; no new state owner
definition_of_done: Requirement implemented and verified by unit tests
non_functional: Message exposed to assistive tech via role=status
